raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was delivered twice: the 02:00 load and a 05:00 replay. The replay carries the same txn_ids (756 = 2 x 378 rows, matching the 5244 - 4866 duplicate txn_ids), but its txn_ts is in epoch milliseconds, so the cast fails; for txn 904489, 1768716186000 ms is exactly 2026-01-18 06:03:06 UTC, the same as its original row. The fix parses both timestamp formats and keeps one row per txn_id (latest ingest) before applying the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, batch_id, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]{12,14}') THEN make_timestamp(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT) * 1000) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
